facts.fact: The BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU states, Niger included, in April 2026 to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026, then on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance institutions 30 June 2027), according to iAfrikan.
